campaign: Integrated validation, phase 2: bounded capability gains and evidence-gated simplification
doctrine:
Preserve the capability freeze enforced by structure: no new model family, workflow, optimizer or general orchestration framework. Construction remains limited to reproduced defects, missing acceptance in existing owners, regression protection and evidence-backed simplification. Owner priority: finish complete model evidence; first repair the reproduced blanket GPU reservation so correctness tests and interactive models share fitting VRAM. Explicit performance and device-wide resource measurements require isolation. Unrelated infrastructure remains behind evidence acquisition. E4B's declared 30-cell bundle was accepted at 5b5f36e4; refresh only affected controls/resources after the retained-output repair, then complete the Gemma 12B FP8 cohort. Infrastructure may interrupt only to repair a reproduced validation blocker or a measured recurring cost; preserve its failing evidence and required checks. Keep every open batch-promotion obligation and full-gate requirement. Use a fixed clean source revision, collect compatible cases per model residency, persist complete cells immediately and resume only missing or invalidated evidence. Measure accepted model-evidence cells per wall-clock hour, repeated executions and gate cost. Infrastructure commits alone do not count as model-validation progress. Do not reduce modality, quality, native-reference, resource or held-out denominators.

docs/plan.json is the sole live execution plan. Retain open row identities and gated historical completion references; depends_on is prerequisite authority and document order ranks ready work. One writer owns each plan edit and gates it before dispatch. Keep live rows focused on deliverable, dependencies and executable acceptance; stable policy belongs in its existing authority and historical evidence in OvergoDB/Git, not repeated narrative. Replanning must preserve every outstanding obligation, lower-bound verifier and stop condition. Campaign closure cannot clear an operator stop.

Fix as you go: reproduce, preserve the failing evidence, correct the cause in its existing owner and rerun affected checks. Recording a finding or marking UNAVAILABLE is not completion. Locate, acquire or construct valid missing fixtures with provenance and frozen oracles; never fabricate evidence or credit skipped, absent, incomplete or zero-matching tests. Correctness, security, data-loss and invalid-measurement defects interrupt affected claims; independent authorized work continues. Raw instruction-model NLL alone is not a defect; retain chat-shaped evaluation and matched-checkpoint references. Never normalize failed measurements into healthy baselines.

Retain parity, longform and report checks as lower bounds. Before a dispatched row starts, use plan -setverify to bind any missing assertion in its owning package. Every acceptance names the exact model/task/case denominator, protocols, source and input identities, thresholds and exclusions; freshness, listings and build success alone cannot prove capability. New named tests are implementation obligations and require their files. Gates consume persisted long-campaign evidence rather than rerunning publication. Store paths use the intended canonical OVERGO_DATA_ROOT.

Validate one complete model bundle at a time, deriving supported modes from artifact/projector declarations, recipes, compatibility claims and oracle fixtures. Prepare datasets and native references on CPU; run owning-package CPU contracts, a fixed small end-to-end diagnostic, required GPU parity, then the full quality/protocol/resource denominator. A diagnostic or activation is not model acceptance. Freeze held-out selection and oracles before measurement; group compatible work by residency while preserving warmups, repeats and isolation. Persist each completed evidence cell immediately. Preserve the accepted E4B bundle and apply the same workflow to a second model; measure operator effort, reloads and repeated verification without reducing coverage. Unsupported modes need artifact-bound exclusions; missing supported modes remain repair obligations.

Commit coherent tested producer/repair batches before clean-source canonical publication. Reuse only exact unaffected evidence with a recorded dependency-independence proof. Each evaluate pass has an explicit measured -budget. Keep all 12032 MMLU-Pro cases and both protocols; MATH is excluded. The full 27B pass remains operator-launched with -budget 3h. Existing benchmark admission does not wait for unrelated simplification. Publish the immutable accepted regression guard before broad execution changes, retain the bound baseline-repair prerequisites, and expand/re-accept full-catalog protection after modality validation. Preserve corpus-at-commit, floors, baseline IDs, surface identity and bounded cancellation.

Extend existing plan/gate/evidence/resource owners. An explicit verification_batch binds base source, scope, acceptance and recovery; checkpoints distinguish implemented, verified and promoted without pruning the parent. Persist independent terminal package successes during execution and cumulative outstanding obligations across kill/restart, replan and scope expansion. Failed or unfinished siblings cannot erase valid independent successes. Change-sensitive selection explains selected/reused/excluded checks and invalidations; prove it in shadow comparisons against full gates before enforcement. Unknown impact broadens checks. Persistence, authentication, concurrency, kernels, public contracts and gate-policy changes trigger required checks immediately. Policy adoption uses the existing full gate and cannot authorize its own reduced checks. Use gate -preflight -paths <cumulative-scope> before admission to collect validation findings. Correct findings through their owners, then run the normal gate. Preflight is diagnostic: no acceptance credit, no store repair; skipped checks remain explicit. Full commit gates remain required until governed checkpoint promotion is implemented. Final promotion requires every cumulative obligation, including elapsed-interval flushes with no new checkpoint.

Enforce physical GPU ownership across worktrees and stores throughout isolated measurement. Use the existing OS-held resource/process lock; heartbeat age alone never authorizes takeover from a live holder. Cover the full consumer lifetime, including child processes; contention invalidates affected resource/performance claims. Independent CPU preparation remains available. Report wall time by phase, reused/executed checks, outstanding obligations, invalidations, failures, repeated loads and accepted evidence cells. Scheduling can change order and proven reuse, never acceptance thresholds or denominators. Complete the bounded control boundary, then return to E4B; defer broad scheduler tuning.

Consolidate shared responsibilities when touching owners: model lookup, admission, resolved inputs and evidence publication should each have one authority. Migrate all callers and remove displaced exports/wrappers in the same batch; preserve protocol/flag/exit/evidence contracts. Repetition triggers an ownership review, not an automatic new executable: first remove the manual step or extend its existing owner. This owner-directed planning rule supersedes the automatic second-use command trigger for this campaign; align skill.md through the existing consolidation row. No new orchestration framework or parallel report format. Command count or file splitting alone is not improvement; measure behavior retained, duplication and maintenance cost removed.

Broad simplification follows the initial modality report, small-model benchmark and each row's regression prerequisites. Preserve the 9964 duplicate-excess ceiling. Compare quality, throughput, peak/retained memory and recovery on identical inputs; no aggregate improvement hides a required regression. Relocation verifies destination and rollback before retiring originals. Retain master ownership of validation/numerics and professional_overgo_gui ownership of HTTP/browser/transport; the audio lane retains its independent plan and development. Use landed intake and integration authorities, without replaying completed merges or importing branch plans.

After model validation, evaluate one bounded existing RSI policy change against a fixed baseline and its ablation on frozen held-out tasks under equal total budgets. Use existing experiment, evaluation, runrecord and report owners. Freeze independent acceptance before candidate generation; the candidate policy cannot alter its judge. Include verification/resource cost, operator interventions, failures and incomplete attempts. A governed loop alone does not prove strategy effectiveness. Negative or inconclusive evidence can close the experiment with an explicit no-promotion decision; it cannot be reported as improvement.

GUI intake boundary: adopt the committed capability projection, media-request lineage, lane dispatch and declared remote-provider contracts described in docs/gui/INTEGRATION.md. Keep GUI/HTTP implementation and its open plan in the GUI lane; master owns validation and numerical/admission repairs. Preserve master's canonical E4B acceptance and data-root contract. Browser, mock relay and hosted generative results prove only their declared contracts; none completes a local model-quality or numerical-parity denominator. Separate remote/backend evidence from reproducible local evidence. Live paid provider evaluation requires explicit authorization. No additional GUI feature work is an E4B prerequisite. Clean-source browser declaration/retirement success and modified-source refusal are distinct evidence dispositions; neither substitutes for the other.

Owner directive: database coordination is a cross-process mutex for a refreshed write transaction, not a server-lifetime reservation. Reuse the OS file-lock owner; no lock daemon. Prove concurrent commits, crash recovery and idle/serving workbench coexistence through transaction-writer and workbench-writer-lifetime before closing the process-control boundary. Recover abandoned gate state through its existing authority under exclusive admission; stale files and process names are never evidence of ownership.

Owner priority 2026-09-07: reduce API surface while implementing each slice. Consolidate duplicated ownership and forwarding wrappers; migrate callers atomically and remove displaced paths. Prefer fewer operations with clear contracts, not new facades over duplicate implementations. Record net exported surface and preserved caller behavior; do not delay validation for an unrelated broad rewrite.

Committed GUI conversation recovery and CPU audio production/segmentation contracts are integrated. Keep both lane plans and newer lane work separate. Reuse the production audio consumers; retain the open native audio streaming admission. Freeze the combined producer after GPU admission repair, then acquire missing catalog guards and refresh only affected E4B controls/resources. Intake and infrastructure commits do not complete model validation.

steps.title: Enforce cheap execution-coverage regression checks before device-wide work
steps.verify: go test ./internal/automationcheck -run 'ModelRegress' -count=1
steps.rationale: Use the code/kernel manifest and typed recipe/operator facts to select a small deterministic model set covering affected weight types, operator paths, head geometry, attention/cache policy and modality; weight type alone is insufficient. Minimize measured run cost subject to coverage, and widen scope when independence is unproven. Compare against the accepted immutable baseline. Sequence the quick model check before broader device work under an exclusive timing lease; host-only changes are explicitly inapplicable. Keep structure-budget checking in the cheap gate phase. Negative tests must reject a missing coverage class, stale/mismatched baseline, untested device path and a reproduced throughput/memory/quality regression. Bind an integration assertion proving the real gate selection and rejection path, alongside the host selector tests; use existing CI/protection ownership to prevent required device evidence being replaced by manual-workflow assumptions. Land the small guard before independent execution fixes; do not wait for media-report or full-catalog expansion. Widen accepted references when the full baseline lands.

items.title: Complete bounded process control after E4B acceptance

steps.title: Prove selective, restart-safe verification and governed batch promotion
steps.verify: go test ./internal/gate -run '^(TestPreflightReportsValidateFindings|TestPreflightSeparatesSkippedChecks|TestPreflightNeverRepairsStore|TestPreflightRejectsCombinedInspection|TestGateStartIndexAdoptsStatRefreshUnderSameTree|TestGateStartIndexRefusesAndPreservesLaterUnplannedStaging)$' -count=1 && go test ./internal/gate -run '^(TestCheckpointPersistenceSurvivesKill|TestCheckpointMemoCoversEveryCommand|TestChangeSelectiveVerificationShadow|TestBatchedGateCostEvidence)$' -count=1 && go test ./internal/gate -run '^(TestIndependentPackageEvidenceAcceptance|TestGovernedBatchDeclarationAcceptance|TestProjectedMergePreflightBeforeVerification|TestGateReusesUnchangedCheckEvidence|TestPackageSelectiveReuse)$' -count=1 && test -f internal/gate/batch_promotion_test.go && go test ./internal/gate -run '^TestBatchPromotionControl$' -count=1 && go test ./internal/gate -run '^TestReusedCheckpointCompletionAuthorityAcceptance$' -count=1 && go test ./internal/repoanalysis -run '^(TestDocsHoldNoUnplannedBinaries|TestDocsInventoryPolicy)$' -count=1 && go test ./internal/gate -run '^TestPreflightRejectsUnplannedDocsBeforeStore$' -count=1 && go test ./internal/gate -run '^TestChangeSelectionUnownedRuntimeInputs$' -count=1 && go test ./internal/plan -run '^TestBatchFlush' -count=1 && go test ./internal/gate -run '^TestCandidateGoPhasesExcludeIgnoredSource$' -count=1 && go test ./internal/gate -run '^TestBatchEvidence' -count=1 && go test ./internal/gate -run '^(TestChangedPackageFailurePreventsBroadSweep|TestModernGoPreflightBindsCandidateCensus|TestStaticFailurePreventsAcceptance|TestGateRunsStaticChecksBeforeAcceptance|TestCheckpointEvidenceReuseAcrossRuns|TestPackageSelectiveReuse|TestTerminalEvidenceRestart)$' -count=1
steps.rationale:
The audio merge already supplies step-local verification batches, exact subordinate completion/recovery evidence and independent per-package cache reuse. Master adds early projected-merge receipt preflight. Preserve these lower bounds; do not implement them again. The remaining work is checkpoint commits without premature parent completion, durable outstanding obligations bound to cumulative changes, mandatory escalation and measured scheduling through the existing plan/gate/OvergoDB owners.

Implement a concrete governed checkpoint path in cmd/gate: record implemented versus verified versus promoted states without pruning the parent. Persist outstanding checks with exact cumulative source/fixture/environment identities, survive interruption/restart, reject orphaning through replan or branch changes, and require one complete final integration gate. Persistence, authentication, concurrency, kernels, public contracts and gate-policy changes immediately trigger their required checks; the controller may adjust scheduling only inside declared limits. Until this exists, full gates remain mandatory for commits. Batch related implementation by capability/dependency, not commit counts; narrower diagnostics do not grant promotion.

Report elapsed wall from the committed run measurement separately from summed phase durations and estimated step time avoided. Include independently reused packages, executed checks, outstanding obligations, failures found and invalidation causes. Privatize gate-only cost types and functions, migrate every caller, and retain exact reporting tests; no additional reporting API. Use the recent GUI merge failures (1757.2s and 1137.7s after successful verification) and final 952.9s run as recorded before evidence for early refusal and scheduling efficiency; do not claim these wall times predict another model. Prove saving and unchanged regression detection on repeated controlled failure/restart/replan cases, including one failed or unavailable package beside a reusable passing package. The exclusive GPU lease finding evidence:sha256:0f4b6d07607b3fa8ee6ee7f320646e5dbbd5b38b025a19c2046d54aed7fa4b4e remains open: consumers must enforce admitted resources before isolated measurements. Never silently weaken acceptance, fabricate fixture evidence or credit skipped cases. Owner directive 2026-09-06 makes this bounded process-control integration the next dispatch and a prerequisite of the remaining E4B acceptance. Finish the declared checkpoints, then return immediately to E4B; adaptive scheduler tuning, broad API cleanup and unrelated infrastructure are deferred. CPU dataset/reference preparation may proceed independently, but isolated evidence requires enforced GPU admission.

Latest before evidence: audio merge cf3f5eb1 passed in 896.5 seconds after an interrupted run and a 592.4-second failure caused by a stale machine-local dataset root. All four explicit acceptances passed, but the later package run resolved the corpus through a different root. Preserve one resolved input contract across acceptance and package tests; validate required paths/identities before expensive verification. The corrected root changes environment identity and correctly invalidates earlier evidence. The successful gate executed 189 packages and credited none of its 472 skipped dependent fixtures. Classify those by affected required acceptance versus optional/platform coverage: resolve every required missing fixture; record unsupported-platform exclusions with exact reasons and never count them as passing. Add prompt failure reporting with the exact package/test while preserving every unrun obligation. Persist successful terminal package reports during process execution, not only after the whole group returns, and prove process-kill/restart reuse without credit for incomplete packages. Keep process supervision, recovery, rename scope, clone/style/permanent-authority preflight and exclusive GPU admission under their existing owners. Checkpoint policy changes require full existing checks and cannot self-authorize a weaker gate.

Selection acceptance: classify cumulative changes to implementation, tests, documentation, fixtures/artifacts/configuration and gate policy using the existing dependency owners. Include transitive consumers, both rename paths, build tags, device mode, toolchain and resolved input identities. Produce a reviewable explanation for every selected, reused or excluded check and every invalidation. Unknown impact broadens the scope. Before enabling narrower enforcement, shadow-compare with the full required gate on a frozen matrix of representative historical changes and injected known failures, including cross-package, fixture-only, rename, kernel, persistence and gate-policy changes. Require zero omitted required checks or missed seeded regressions; preserve the full matrix denominator and actual timings. A documentation-only change may reuse independent runtime evidence only when the dependency proof supports it. Gate-policy changes themselves use the existing full gate, never their proposed reduced policy.

Restart acceptance: publish each terminal passing package/checkpoint atomically to OvergoDB as it finishes, independently of a later failed, skipped or killed sibling. Bind deferred obligations to the cumulative batch and exact dependencies; demonstrate kill/restart, replan and scope expansion without losing obligations or accepting partial/zero-match runs. Report the precise failing package/test promptly and repair in scope before closure.

GPU acceptance: use the existing resource owner to exclude competing consumers of the same physical GPU across worktrees and stores, for the entire admitted run. Test contention, process death, stale-owner recovery and release; unexpected competing use invalidates isolated performance/resource claims. GPU reservation must not serialize independent CPU preparation.

Integration acceptance: TestBatchPromotionControl must exercise implemented/checkpointed, verified and promoted transitions, outstanding-check refusal, all mandatory escalation classes and final cumulative acceptance. Compare cold and resumed verification on the same frozen change matrix; report wall time by phase, reused/executed checks, repeated model loads, outstanding obligations and failures detected. Require measured reduction in repeated work on unchanged dependencies without weaker acceptance; record observed savings rather than inventing a universal speedup floor. Scheduling may reorder or reuse proven checks within declared limits, never alter denominators or thresholds.

Landed lower bounds: checkpoint memo with compound-command coverage/refusal; per-check retry persistence with subprocess restart proof; three synthetic selection counterexamples; acceptance/failure/cost telemetry; batch flush declarations. The reviewed 719c32cb intake adds diagnostic preflight, explicit skip reporting, no closure repair during preflight, mutually exclusive modes, and stat-only index refresh recovery. Retain their bound tests. Cache persistence is not cumulative OvergoDB obligations; synthetic import graphs are not the full selection matrix; flush declarations are not promotion; summed step durations are not parallel elapsed wall.

Remaining correctness proofs: selection covers external/subprocess consumers, fixtures, build modes, renames, kernels, persistence and gate policy; unknown reachability keeps required checks. GPU ownership uses a stable physical-resource domain across worktrees and stores, with OS-held exclusion, live-owner contention, process/child death and restart tests; stale heartbeat never grants ownership. Promotion reevaluates elapsed intervals at current time even when all checkpoints are already recorded, survives restart, and consumes every required obligation before parent completion. Exercise exact boundary, no-new-checkpoint and trailing-obligation cases. Reuse existing owners; no parallel scheduler.

Excluded from master: Hatchet lane plan, open lane work, heartbeat-based device takeover, static dependency exclusions, automatic literal exemptions, conditional workflows and broader scheduling/replay features. These are not E4B prerequisites or presumed future imports. Any later admission needs an independently bound correctness test and measured validation benefit. Preserve semantic literal authority; lexical zero/one, min/max, math calls, shadowed imports and strconv arguments are not automatic policy exemptions.

GUI intake selection coverage: extend the frozen full-gate shadow matrix with embedded JavaScript/assets, browser subprocesses, provider declaration and key changes, proxy admission, remote run-record classification and plan lane dispatch. Trace consumers through embedding, environment inputs and subprocess contracts, not Go imports alone. Authentication, persistence, public contracts and gate-policy changes retain mandatory escalation. Keep TestGeneratorUsesUpdatedKey in internal/remoterelay and the media-to-chat attachment case in TestWebUIBrowserAcceptance as bound lower bounds; browser acceptance must run through cmd/webui-lane, never receive credit from its outside-lane skip. Reuse terminal passing checks only with exact independence evidence; do not rerun a whole model bundle for a UI-only change when that proof exists.
